text: Overdosage Section In case of overdosage, discontinue medication, treat symptomatically and institute supportive measures. Dialysis does not alter serum half-life and thus would not be of benefit in treating cases of overdosage. Please review the manufacturer's complete drug information available from the FDA at www.fda.gov Permanent Link: https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=3d9aa97a-665a-44d4-990f-3d1a54c04174
